description:
Wire UIContext.add_autocomplete_provider to the autocomplete system.

Implement:
- Extensions call add_autocomplete_provider(factory) via UIContext
- Factory wraps the base provider, adding/filtering/reordering suggestions
- Multiple extensions can stack wrappers (composition chain)
- Re-setup autocomplete provider when extensions load/reload

Upstream: interactive-mode.ts addAutocompleteProvider, setupAutocompleteProvider
Depends on: autocomplete provider API, UIContext wiring
title: Autocomplete provider stacking from extensions
